sloka: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः ।मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ ।। ५.६८.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ ।mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasannidhau ।। 5.68.21 ।।।।

translations.english: 'There are monkeys who are more powerful than me or equal to me. None are less strong than me or Sugriva.
